title: prunus avium var. dulcis
intro: Prunus avium var. dulcis, commonly known as sweet cherry, is a deciduous tree species of the Prunus genus. This plant is known for its edible fruit, sweet cherry, which is rich in nutrients and offers several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Prunus avium var. dulcis include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
